title: adina orientalis
intro: Adina orientalis, commonly known as Burma rubber or Indian rubber, is a tropical evergreen tree native to Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties. The therapeutic actions of Adina orientalis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which contribute to its use in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
